phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) module used for solar power generation, typically assembled with encapsulated solar cells, protective glass, and structural frame to convert sunlight into electricity.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon PV modules dominate the solar industry with about 85% market share due to their high efficiency (around 20-22%) and widespread adoption in residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar installations worldwide as of 2024.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA or POE)

components.name: Mounting Brackets and Hardware

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Silicon
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Core semiconductor material providing photovoltaic conversion in monocrystalline solar cells, universally essential with no practical substitute.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Silver
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Used for front contact metallization to collect electrical current efficiently; industry standard with some copper alternatives emerging.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Aluminum
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Commonly used for back contact and frame material, providing mechanical support and electrical connectivity, an industry standard.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Boron
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Standard p-type dopant used in silicon solar cells to create necessary electrical properties, with few alternatives like gallium.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Phosphorus
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Standard n-type dopant for creating the PN junction in the cells; arsenic can occasionally substitute but phosphorus is preferred.

Solar Cell.name: Silicon
Solar Cell.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material used for photovoltaic energy conversion; essential in most solar cells.

Solar Cell.name: Silver
Solar Cell.reasoning: Front contact metallization material to facilitate current collection, standard in solar cell manufacturing.

Solar Cell.name: Aluminum
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used mainly for back surface contacts and structural elements; standard industry practice.

Solar Cell.name: Boron
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used as a dopant to create p-type silicon; common though alternatives like gallium exist.

Solar Cell.name: Phosphorus
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used as an n-type dopant; essential for PN junction formation with occasional arsenic substitution.

Glass Cover.name: Glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Primary material providing mechanical protection and optical clarity for the solar panel; industry standard for covers.

Glass Cover.name: Borosilicate glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Sometimes used for enhanced durability and thermal resistance, but standard glass is more common and sufficient.

Junction Box.name: Copper
Junction Box.reasoning: Essential electrical conductor within the junction box, allowing current collection and transfer, industry standard.

Junction Box.name: Aluminum
Junction Box.reasoning: Sometimes used for structural parts in junction boxes but not universally essential, substitutes exist.

Chassis Assembly.name: Aluminum
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Widely used as frame and structural material for solar panel chassis due to strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance.

Chassis Assembly.name: Stainless steel
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Often used for mounting components and hardware within the chassis assembly, though aluminum can substitute.

Chassis Assembly.name: Copper
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Used in some chassis bonding and grounding parts, but alternatives exist.

Encapsulation Material.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Encapsulation Material.reasoning: Used as a protective film layer in encapsulation for its optical clarity and durability, common base for encapsulants.

Encapsulation Material.name: Ethylene glycol
Encapsulation Material.reasoning: Used as a chemical intermediate in polymeric encapsulation materials, moderately confident due to possible alternatives.

Encapsulation Material.name: Epoxy resins
Encapsulation Material.reasoning: Common encapsulation resin material providing adhesion and protection.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Copper
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Primary conductor material offering excellent electrical conductivity and flexibility, standard in cables.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Polyethylene
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Used for cable insulation and sheathing owing to electrical insulation properties and durability.

Interconnect Ribbons.name: Copper
Interconnect Ribbons.reasoning: Primary material for interconnect ribbons due to high electrical conductivity and malleability.

Interconnect Ribbons.name: Silver
Interconnect Ribbons.reasoning: Sometimes used as coating to enhance conductivity and corrosion resistance, though not always required.

Interconnect Ribbons.name: Polyimide
Interconnect Ribbons.reasoning: Used for flexible, heat-resistant insulating films on interconnect ribbons.

Mounting Brackets And Hardware.name: Stainless steel
Mounting Brackets And Hardware.reasoning: Common material for mounting brackets and hardware due to strength, corrosion resistance, and durability.

Mounting Brackets And Hardware.name: Aluminum
Mounting Brackets And Hardware.reasoning: Often used for mounting hardware due to light weight and corrosion resistance but less robust than stainless steel.
